synopsis: Set and filmed in Luton, Ish follows 12 year old best friends Ish (Farhan Hasnat) and Maram (Yahya Kitana), who wrestle to hold onto their friendship in the wake of a police stop and search. synopsis: Immerse yourself in Paul Simon's timeless 'Graceland' at Pitchblack Playback's listening session in the dark, celebrating the iconic album's 40th anniversary. Hear this stunning record played loud in uncompressed full-resolution audio on our powerful Screen One sound system. No phones; no talking; no signing; no distractions; just you and the music. "This sounds great' - Rick Rubin "A fabulous idea" - Jay Kay, Jamiroquai "The optimal way to listen to an album" - Max Richter "This might just be m
tmdb_overview: Singer-songwriter Paul Simon had been on the cutting-edge of pop music throughout most of the 1960s and the '70s, first as half of the seminal folk-rock duo Simon & Garfunkel, and then as a well-received solo artist. But the rise of 1980s rock and new wave saw a decline in Simon's commercial success, and the singer responded by experimenting with different musical styles--most notably, world beat--that culminated in his adventurous 1986 masterpiece GRACELAND. The album's fusion of American folk-rock songwriting and buoyant South African rhythms not only broke new ground in pop music, but became Simon's biggest-selling solo record. This episode of the CLASSIC ALBUMS series examines the making of Simon's groundbreaking work through interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, music videos, and live performances of album tracks such as "Boy in the Bubble," "Diamonds on the Soles of Her Shoes," "You Can Call Me Al," and "Under African Skies."

movie_title_en: Cine-Real presents: The Good, The Bad & The Ugly
synopsis: During the American Civil War, gunslinger Blondie and wanted outlaw Tuco form a volatile partnership in pursuit of a buried cache of Confederate gold. Ruthless mercenary Angel Eyes is chasing the same fortune, forcing the three men through shifting alliances, battlefield chaos and a final showdown in a remote cemetery. Sergio Leone’s operatic Spaghetti Western, powered by Ennio Morricone’s iconic score, is a landmark of the genre. Ciné-Real is one of the only film clubs in the UK to exclusively
tmdb_overview: One day while overseeing a documentary crew filming his blind father at work, Im Dong-hwan gets a phone call that his missing mother’s remains have been found after forty years. Determined to find the truth of her disappearance, Dong-hwan embarks on a twisted odyssey through his family’s traumatic past, uncovering dark secrets along the way.

tmdb_overview: An island populated entirely by happy, flightless birds or almost entirely. tmdb_overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

The thrilling story of E. Jean Carroll’s life, from her early days as Miss Cheerleader USA to her rise as a trailblazing journalist, author, and beloved advice columnist. Carroll broke barriers as the first female editor at Esquire, Playboy, and Outside, helping to redefine women’s roles in media with her sharp wit and fearless voice. In recent years, she reignited public discourse by standing up to power, becoming the only woman to beat Donald Trump twice in court, and sparking a national conversation about truth, accountability, and resilience. A portrait of an indomitable woman who proved it’s never too late to reclaim your voice, rewrite your story, and change the world.

After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In doing so, she finds letters that reveal a family secret intertwined with the memory of the peninsular town’s inhabitants. tmdb_title: Gaza's Twins, Come Back to Me
tmdb_overview: When the Israeli army invades the Gaza Strip in 2023, Rania is eight months pregnant. She gives birth to triplets just as her hometown in northern Gaza is bombed. One girl dies at birth, while the other two babies, Jowan and her brother Hamoud, are so weak that they have to be placed in an incubator. When the hospital is evacuated, the twins are moved to southern Gaza, where Rania’s sister Nisreen takes over their care. A travel ban prevents the babies from returning to their mother.

tmdb_overview: A particular reading of the hard years of famine, repression and censorship after the massacre of the Spanish Civil War (1936-39), through popular culture: songs, newspapers and magazines, movies and newsreels.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from within
tmdb_overview: Caudillo is a documentary film by Spanish film director Basilio Martín Patino. It follows the military and political career of Francisco Franco and the most important moments of the Spanish Civil War. It uses footage from both sides of the war, music from the period and voice-over testimonies of various people.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Spain in the 1930s is the place to be for a man of action like Robert Jordan. There is a civil war going on and Jordan—who has joined up on the side that appeals most to idealists of that era—has been given a high-risk assignment up in the mountains. He awaits the right time to blow up a crucial bridge in order to halt the enemy's progress.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War
tmdb_overview: The film centres on Moncho and his coming-of-age experience in Galicia in 1936. Moncho develops a close relationship with his teacher Don Gregorio who introduces the boy to different things in the world. While the story centres on Moncho's ordinary coming-of-age experiences, tensions related to the looming Spanish Civil War periodically interrupt Moncho's personal growth and daily life.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Edee, in the aftermath of an unfathomable event, finds herself unable to stay connected to the world she once knew and in the face of that uncertainty, retreats to the magnificent, but unforgiving, wilds of the Rockies. After a local hunter brings her back from the brink of death, she must find a way to live again.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Joris Ivens’s advocacy documentary for the Republican cause intercuts a besieged Madrid with a nearby village digging an irrigation canal, linking the war to bread, land, and survival. Produced by the writers’ collective Contemporary Historians, edited by Helen van Dongen, scored by Marc Blitzstein, and narrated in its U.S. version by Ernest Hemingway (after an initial Orson Welles track), it blends frontline reportage with persuasion against Franco’s forces and their German–Italian backers.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from within
tmdb_overview: The creative and ambitious Carlos, a young Spanish film buff, manages to become a professional camera operator with time and effort, and is also blessed with the love of Ana, which he has longed for; but the outbreak of the Civil War in 1936 changes everything for both of them.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War
tmdb_overview: A small Spanish town, Villar del Río, is alerted to the upcoming visit of American diplomats and its ruling townsmen begin preparations to impress the American visitors, in the hopes of benefiting under the Marshall Plan. Hoping to demonstrate the side of Spanish culture with which the visiting foreign officials would be more familiarized, the Castilian citizens don unfamiliar Andalusian costumes, hire a renowned flamenco performer, and re-decorate their town in Andalusian style, meantime waiting for their uncertain arrival.

synopsis: Another campaign film

synopsis:
500 Miles 
Genre(s): DramaUK/Ireland/Cyprus | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Morgan MatthewsStars: Loré Adewusi, Dexter Sol Ansell, Eoin Duffy, Clare Dunne, Roman Griffin Davis, Deirdre Monaghan, Bill Nighy, David Ryan, Harleen Sahota, Michael Socha.Our 2pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and will be followed by a post screening discussion with the Croydon U3A film group. In this emotional and involving drama, Finn and his brother
Charlie run away from their Yorkshire home to escape the turmoil of their
fractured family life and avoid being separated from each other by their
divorcing parents. Carried along by their own quick wits and the kindness of
strangers, they head to the wild west coast of Ireland, the home of their
beloved but estranged grandfather. This life affirming road movie is cleverly
interwoven with flashbacks of joyful memories and features outstanding performances
from a multi generational cast.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
A Private Life 
Genre(s): Drama/MysteryFrance | 2026 | 107 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Rebecca ZlotowskiCast: Jodie Foster, Daniel Auteuil, Virginie Efira
Foster plays Lilian
Steiner, an American
psychiatrist adrift in Paris —
divorced, estranged from her son, and losing herself in her patients' troubles.
When one of her patients is found dead in an apparent suicide, Steiner can't let it go. Armed with little more
than professional instinct and the reluctant company of her ex-husband played
by Daniel Auteil, she begins to dig. What unfolds is part Hitchcockian thriller
and part wry relationship comedy.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.

synopsis:
An American in Paris 
Genre(s): Romance/MusicalUSA | 1951 | 113 minsDirector: Vincente MinnelliStars: Gene Kelly, Leslie Caron, Oscar Levant
Based
on George Gershwin’s tone poem of the same name, which accompanies the ballet
sequence at the film’s climax, as well as songs from the Gershwin catalogue,
this multi-Oscar winning musical stars Kelly as Jerry, a WWII veteran
struggling to succeed as an artist, who falls for Lise (Caron), without
realising she is the girlfriend of his best friend, French singer Henri. Among
other delights in the film is a sequence where Oscar Levant dreams of playing
Gershwin’s Piano Concerto in F – and becomes the conductor, the other musicians
and even a member of the audience!
tmdb_overview: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.

synopsis:
Birds of War 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUK/Syria/Lebanon | 2026 | 85 mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Directors: Janay Boulos, Abd Alkader Habak
Birds of War follows
London-based Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos and Syrian activist photographer
Abd Alkader Habak as they piece together their extraordinary long-distance
relationship through 13 years of personal footage, spanning years of
revolutions, war, displacement and exile. From the devastation of Aleppo to a
London newsroom, the film offers an intimate view of life on the frontline and
the emotional turmoil of conflict. Both a powerful documentary and a deeply
personal love story, it asks whether love can survive distance, danger,
profound change and differences. Sundance Film Festival 2026, World Cinema
Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact. 
This work contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis:
Cactus Pears  +ShortGenre(s): DramaUK/India/Canada | 2025 | 112 mins (Marathi with English Subtitles)Director: Rohan KanawadeStars: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap, Nitin Bansode, Harish Baraskar, Ram Daund, Vidya Joshi, Hemant Kadam, Rani Kasliwal, Vaishali Kendale
Cactus Pears is a
tender and deeply personal drama set against the striking landscapes of rural
Western India. Following the death of his father, Anand returns from Mumbai to
his ancestral village to observe traditional mourning rituals. Amid mounting
family expectations to marry, he finds an unexpected refuge in Balya, a
childhood friend. As old bonds are rekindled, their connection deepens into
something more. Beautifully shot, Kanawade’s debut is a subtle, moving
exploration of grief, identity and love. Sundance Film Festival 2025 World
Cinema Grand Jury Prize winner. 
Preceded by Two Black Boys in Paradise (9 mins), a
BAFTA-winning animated short.
tmdb_overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

synopsis:
Come See Me In the Good Light 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUSA | 2025 ! 104 minsDirector: Ryan
WhiteCast: Megan Falley, Andrea Gibson
Introduction and Q&A with Jo Scanlan and Mia Bayes, Director of BFI Filmmaking Fund
Tickets are free but please consider making a donation to the cinema when booking.

This Oscar-nominated
documentary tells the story of poets and lovers Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley,
and how they deal with the former’s diagnosis of ovarian cancer. Through the
highs and lows of the ongoing treatment, the partners attempt to live a full
and happy life, which the film reflects through their poetry, prose, raunchy
jokes and bedtime whispers. A celebration of queer love under the deepest of
traumas.
tmdb_title: Come See Me in the Good Light
tmdb_original_title: Come See Me in the Good Light
tmdb_overview: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.

Fame 
Genre(s): Drama/MusicalUSA| 1980 | 134 MinsDirector: Alan ParkerStars: Eddie Barth, Lee Curreri, Irene Cara.Set in New York’s High School of Performing Arts, Fame follows a disparate group of students from different backgrounds as they audition and then study at the school. We see how they progress across four years of study, as they aim to make it big in their chosen areas of the entertainment world. Various audition and performance scenes, along with the characters’ personal experiences are expertly woven into Christopher Gore’s screenplay, and the result is a joyful celebration of youth, hope and talent.

Finding Emily 
Genre(s): Comedy/RomanceUK/USA | 2026 | 111 minsDirector: Alicia MacDonaldCast: Angourie Rice, Spike Fearn, Minnie Driver, Phil Wang, Yali Topol Margalith
Just in time for summer, we’re thrilled to present Finding Emily, a homegrown romcom very much in the style of Notting Hill and Rye Lane. Set in Manchester, the film follows Owen, a young musician who goes on a night out and meets Emily, the girl of his dreams — only to discover the next morning that the phone number she gave him is missing a digit. So, with the help of another Emily (a psychology student with her own motive for joining the hunt), he begins a quest across campus to find his elusive love.

synopsis:
Ish 
Genre: DramaUK | 2025 | 89 minsDirector: Imran PerrettaStars: Farhan Hasnat, Yahya Kitana, Sudha Bhuchar
Set in Luton, this coming-of-age drama
follows 12-year-old best friends Ish and Maram (non-professional actors Farhan
Hasnat and Yahya Kitana, themselves friends since childhood) as they try to
make the most of their summer. After a traumatic police stop-and-search
incident, cracks begin to appear in their friendship, forcing the boys to
confront the realities of growing up in a world that views them with
suspicion. As their lives gradually
diverge, each must make sense of the men they are becoming and learn that
letting go can be one of the hardest parts of growing up. A contemporary
portrait of British childhood exploring masculinity, friendship and racial
profiling and facial recognition technology with compassion and insight.
This work contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.

synopsis:
Nino 
Genre(s): DramaFrance | 2025 | 97 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Pauline LoquèsStars: Théodore Pellerin, William Lebghil, Salomé
Dewaels
NINO contains a sequence of flashing lights, 
which might affect viewers with photosensitive epilepsy.
One Friday in Paris, his 29th birthday, Nino
receives an unexpected cancer diagnosis. With chemotherapy due to start on
Monday, he is given the delicate task of producing a sperm sample in case the
treatment leaves him infertile. This incredibly moving and often funny French
drama sees Nino spend the weekend adrift in Paris, attempting to
reconnect with others and stumbling over the words to share his shocking news.
Théodore Pellerin's tender performance won prizes at both Cannes and the Césars
in this promising debut feature.
tmdb_overview: Nino is a young man on a journey to reconnect with the world and himself in the streets of Paris, following the suggestion of his doctors. In three days, he will face a major challenge.

synopsis:
NT Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses 
Genre: Theatrical PerformanceUK | 2026 | 180 minsDirector: Marianne ElliottStars: Lesley Manville, Aidan Turner, Monica Barbaro
BAFTA Award-winner Lesley Manville (Phantom Thread) joins
Aidan Turner (Rivals) in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s
celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons
of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.  Marquise de Merteuil is a
master in the art of survival. Alongside the magnetic Vicomte de Valmont, they
turn seduction into strategy and weaponise desire. But when their alliance
collapses into rivalry, the battle between them threatens to destroy everyone
in their path. Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Marianne Elliott (Angels
in America) directs this thrilling game of love, lies, and social warfare.
There will be a 15 minute interval at the end of act 1. Our Arts Bar will reopen to allow customers to purchase drinks and snacks to take into the cinema.

role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy.Telling the truth isn’t always that

despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society. But the more she

her truth in a world that would rather silence her.

The Dresser 
Genre(s): DramaUK | 1983 | 118 minsDirector: Peter YatesStars: Albert Finney, Tom Courtenay, Edward Fox, Eileen Atkins, Betty Marsden.
Ronald Harwood adapted his own acclaimed play, which was
based on his own experiences working as a dresser for actor-manager Sir Donald
Wolfit, portrayed as ‘Sir’. Sir is leading a theatre group performing
Shakespeare in the provinces during the war, but his mental capacities are
beginning to fade, and Norman, his dresser, has the task of nursing him into
another performance of King Lear. Courtenay recreates his theatre performance
as the sensitive Norman and Finney delivers a barn-storming Sir.
A 35mm presentation in association with The Cinema Museum.
tmdb_overview: One fateful night in a small English regional theatre during World War II a troupe of touring actors stage a production of Shakespeares King Lear. Bombs are falling, sirens are wailing, the curtain is up in an hour but the actor/manager Sir who is playing Lear is nowhere to be seen. His dresser Norman must scramble to keep the production alive but will Sir turn up in time and if he does will he be able to perform that night? The Dresser is a wickedly funny and deeply moving story of friendship and loyalty as Sir reflects on his lifelong accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

synopsis:

Genre: DramaSri Lanka | 1978 | 110 mins (Sinhala with English Subtitles)Director: Sumitra PeriesStars: Vasanthi Chathurani, Ajith Jinadasa, Shayama AnandanThe BFI have released this
restoration of this well-loved film from 1978. Set in rural Sri Lanka, it tells
of schoolgirl Kusum, who cleans the house of a wealthy family, including their
son Nimal. He volunteers to tutor her through her exams, and although she knows
it will be frowned upon, she forms a romantic attachment to him. Meanwhile, her
younger sister Soma, enters beauty pageants and dreams of becoming a movie star
and escaping her lowly existence. Both Vasanthi Chathurani, who plays Kusum,
and director Sumitra Peries went on to have distinguished careers in Sri Lankan
cinema.

well-known faces from TV Scandi noir). A well-acted black comedy, full of
hilarious misadventures and fun slapstick sequences.
tmdb_overview: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are.

George
Hardy is a shepherd living in a quiet English rural community, keeping himself
to himself, and reading crime books to his flock every evening. Little does he
know that they understand every word, and when he is discovered dead, the sheep
suspect foul play and start to investigate under the noses of the incompetent
local police. The talking sheep are voiced by an array of British and American
screen talent and Emma Thompson delivers a great cameo as George’s solicitor.
Think Babe meets The Thursday Murder Club.

As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
The Summer Book follows an intergenerational family spending a transformative summer at their rustic vacation home on an unspoiled, remote island in the Gulf of Finland. 

Adapted from Tove Jansson’s beloved novel, the film explores grief, nature, and the delicate bonds between a young girl, her wise grandmother (Glenn Close), and her grieving father (Anders Danielsen Lie).

synopsis:
Celebrating 50 years of Aardman, the Bristol-based stop motion animation studio.

A plucky cave man named Dug, his sidekick Hognob and the rest of their tribe face a grave threat to their simple existence. Lord Nooth plans to take over their land and transform it into a giant mine, forcing Dug and his clan to dig for precious metals. Not ready to go down without a fight, Dug and Hognob must unite their people in an epic quest to defeat a mighty enemy -- the Bronze Age.
tmdb_overview: Dug, along with his sidekick Hognob, unite a cavemen tribe to save their hidden valley from being spoiled and, all together as a team, to face the menace of a mysterious and mighty enemy, on the turf of an ancient and sacred sport.

synopsis:
A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, convinced he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he reveals an unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past. 

This star-studded, darkly comedic drama is led by spellbinding performances from Academy Award nominees Bill Nighy and Imelda Staunton, BAFTA nominee George MacKay, BAFTA winner Dominic West, Johnny Flynn, and rising star Noah Jupe.

movie_title: TEENAGE SEX AND DEATH AT CAMP MIASMA
movie_title_en: TEENAGE SEX AND DEATH AT CAMP MIASMA
synopsis:
After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, of Hacks fame) for resurrection. But when she visits the original movie’s star (Gillian Anderson), a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

Jane Schoenbrun (I Saw the TV Glow) gives us a playful open-hearted slasher about sex and cinema.

synopsis: <p><em>Goodbye, Dragon Inn</em> (2003) is a beautiful, melancholic and funny exploration of intimacy and isolation over the course of the last day at a closing picture palace in Taipei City, Taiwan. </p>\n

All three are coming to terms with the recent death of Sophia’s mother in very different ways.

synopsis: Join us August 13 at Coldharbour Blue for a summer social and a screening of Point Break! 🌊 Arrive from 7:00 pm to mingle at the bar, then settle in for a cozy cinema experience of a ’90s summer classic. The film starts at 8:00 pm.

synopsis: In the late 1990s, Gavin Bain and Billy Boyd had their musical ambitions consistently ridiculed for having the ‘wrong’ accents, so they went for broke and reinvented themselves as Californian rappers. The duo re-recorded their own tracks with fake accents and turned up in London claiming to be an established duo on the Cali scene as well as childhood friends with Eminem. They quickly bagged themselves a record deal, a hefty sum in advances, and an appearance on MTV… until it all came crashing do
tmdb_overview: A teen seductress pulls three other privileged Malibu kids into her devious scheme, and unforeseen consequences force the group to face their own fears and mortality.

synopsis: A young farmer in rural Yorkshire numbs his daily frustrations with binge drinking and casual sex, until the arrival of a Romanian migrant worker.
tmdb_overview: Manu travels from Dubai to Kochi to attain his goal, without which he will be in trouble. Public prosecutor Mathew Tharakan and taxi driver Muhammed have their own intentions to be pursued as well. Vasudeva Sanal's God's Own Country narrates the story of what happens to the three as they try to reach their destination.

synopsis: STARR – London-based electronic folk-pop artist STARR creates immersive live performances through voice, guitar, violin and live looping. Building each song from scratch, she fuses organic instrumentation with electronic textures to craft a sound that is intimate, atmospheric and uniquely her own. Join her for her very first single release show at Coldharbour cinema for a night of live music, self made on screen visuals, poetic lyricism and live electronic production.

Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan's three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom's resistance to foll...
tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

Two train stewardess BFFs switch from a dull railway to the luxurious Glamazonian Express. During a massive storm, they must work with snooty first-class crew and President Gagwell to prevent disaster in LA.
tmdb_overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

People sit alone and motionless in their apartments. There are long shots of empty halls. Paint peels. The flooring on upper levels is linoleum. Hall lights are florescent. Doors open a crack then close.

tmdb_overview: Denmark is in deep crisis: the country is hit by general strike, during the holding of a NATO summit in Copenhagen. Meanwhile, a minister is kidnapped by extremists, and state power cracks down against politically-active leftists.

tmdb_overview: A slice of life of a group of young working class friends in a Northern French village coming to the end of their school years and embarking upon adult life. The film follows the choices and decisions made for their futures.

synopsis: The sunlit French Riviera becomes the backdrop for Alfred Hitchcock’s thriller, pairing a suave Cary Grant and sparkling Grace Kelly.
tmdb_overview: When a string of jewel robberies hits the French Riviera, suspicion falls on retired thief John “The Cat” Robie. To clear his name, he sets out to trap the copycat himself—entangling a wealthy widow and her beguiling daughter in a seductive game of pursuit, deception, and desire.

synopsis: Maurice Pialat’s cinematic series, charting life in a small country village during the First World War, can finally be seen, fully restored, on the big screen.
Britain’s favourite bear is back for some more family fun!
tmdb_overview: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.

synopsis: Anthony Hopkins is superb in Richard Attenborough’s uncharacteristically dark tale of a ventriloquist whose doll might just have a life of its own.
tmdb_overview: A ventriloquist is at the mercy of his vicious dummy while he tries to renew a romance with his high school sweetheart.

synopsis: Sian Clifford’s narcissistic aristocrat hires a crew to film her life, but her obsession with attention soon twists into something surreal and unsettling.
tmdb_overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

synopsis: In one of his finest films, Peter Watkins brilliantly reinvents the ‘artist biopic’ to create an expansive yet intimate portrait of the youthful Edvard Munch.
tmdb_overview: Edvard Munch's childhood is overshadowed by death: he suffers the loss of his sister and mother, while enduring serious illness himself, almost dying. At university, Munch discovers his talent as a painter. As he immerses himself in the art world, he becomes part of a cultural revolution led by the likes of nihilist Hans Jæger.

synopsis: Michelangelo Antonioni’s devastating film features Monica Vitti as a woman struggling to keep her hold on reality.
tmdb_overview: In an industrializing Italian town, a married woman, rendered mentally unstable after a traffic accident, drifts into an affair with a friend of her husband.

synopsis: Sofia Coppola’s second film set in a hotel finds a jaded Hollywood star re-connecting with the world through his relationship with his daughter.
tmdb_overview: After withdrawing to the Chateau Marmont, a passionless Hollywood actor reexamines his life when his eleven-year-old daughter surprises him with a visit.

Alice in Wonderland is presented through the lens and wild imagination of great Czech auteur Jan Švankmajer.
tmdb_overview: A quiet young English girl named Alice finds herself in an alternate version of her own reality after chasing a white rabbit. She becomes surrounded by living inanimate objects and stuffed dead animals, and must find a way out of this nightmare - no matter how twisted or odd that way must be.

synopsis: Pedro Almodóvar’s Oscar-winning masterpiece is a deeply moving, richly colourful tribute to motherhood, friendship and the families we create for ourselves.
tmdb_overview: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a pregnant, HIV-positive nun.

synopsis: Sandrine Bonnaire is remarkable in her César-garlanded screen debut, playing a teenage girl grappling with her burgeoning sexuality.
tmdb_overview: Fifteen-year-old Suzanne seeks refuge from a disintegrating family in a series of impulsive, promiscuous affairs. Her fulsome sexuality further ratchets up the suppressed passions of her narcissistic brother, insecure mother and brooding, authoritarian father.

synopsis: The BBC banned Peter Watkins’ notorious films about a future nuclear attack, and yet in 1966 it won an Oscar – for best documentary.
tmdb_overview: A docudrama depicting a hypothetical nuclear attack on Britain.  After backing the film's development, the BBC refused to air it, publicly stating "the effect of the film has been judged by the BBC to be too horrifying for the medium of broadcasting." It debuted in theaters in 1966 and went on to great acclaim, but remained unseen on British television until 1985.

synopsis: Cornish auteur Mark Jenkin returns with a political folktale of two fishermen locked in a time-loop.
tmdb_overview: A mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

synopsis: The discovery of a portal into the mind of actor John Malkovich is the catalyst for comedy and high drama in this utterly original and surreal cult favourite.
tmdb_overview: One day at work, unsuccessful puppeteer Craig finds a portal into the head of actor John Malkovich. The portal soon becomes a passion for anybody who enters its mad and controlling world of overtaking another human body.

synopsis: Wong Kar Wai delivers an exquisite melodrama about two married neighbours who gradually fall in love.
tmdb_overview: Two neighbors form a strong bond after both suspect extramarital activities of their spouses. However, they agree to keep their bond platonic so as not to commit similar wrongs.

synopsis: Long-thought-lost film The Web, along with other films, illustrate the power of Peter Watkins’ early vision in addressing conflict and revolution through collaboration with amateur actors.
A lonely alien is befriended by children who set out to help it return home.
tmdb_overview: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliott who decides to keep him hidden in his home. While a task force hunts for the extra-terrestrial, Elliott, his brother, and his little sister Gertie form an emotional bond with their new friend, and try to help him find his way home.

Effectively, they perform up to their expectations. However, as the army men have to march northward, their moment of glory finishes heartlessly.

synopsis: Emmy Award-winning writer Mark Gatiss returns as Gabriel Book, with three new mysteries to solve.
Marilyn Monroe’s final film is a poignant and poetic drama, infused with the promise of what could have been had she had more time to explore her skills as a dramatic performer.
tmdb_overview: While filing for a divorce, beautiful ex-stripper Roslyn Taber ends up meeting aging cowboy-turned-gambler Gay Langland and former World War II aviator Guido Racanelli. The two men instantly become infatuated with Roslyn and, on a whim, the three decide to move into Guido's half-finished desert home together. When grizzled ex-rodeo rider Perce Howland arrives, the unlikely foursome strike up a business capturing wild horses.

synopsis: The Star Wars saga continues, with Master Yoda teaching young apprentice Luke Skywalker in the ways of the Force.
tmdb_overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

synopsis: Monica Vitti dominates this tale of female resilience against a backdrop of 20th-century Italian history.
tmdb_overview: Teresa gets her first taste of crime -- and its consequences -- when, during World War II, she is nabbed for robbing an apartment. But being poor and perpetually starving, the pretty petty thief doesn't give up her quest for ill-gotten gains and soon turns to pick-pocketing. Despite her questionable thieving skills, the bumbling crook tries scheme after scheme, pilfering from strangers and dodging the law as she searches for a way to fund an adequate meal.

synopsis: The monotony of work is juxtaposed against an otherworldly, dream-like space in early 1980s London.
tmdb_overview: As night falls, the receptionist of a small hotel dutifully performs her routine tasks while strange lodgers descend upon the dark corners of the inn.

synopsis: A series of fantastic worlds can be discovered at the top of a magical tree in an enchanted wood in a film based on Enid Blyton’s beloved books.
tmdb_overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

synopsis: Winner of the Best Picture Academy Award and a huge box-office hit, Grand Hotel remains a glamorous relic from Hollywood’s golden age.
tmdb_overview: Guests at a posh Berlin hotel struggle through worry, scandal, and heartache.

synopsis: Sian Clifford’s narcissistic aristocrat hires a crew to film her life, but her obsession with attention soon twists into something surreal and unsettling.
tmdb_overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

synopsis: Riveting camerawork meets revolutionary ideas in this utterly unique, hugely influential film.
tmdb_overview: A study in contrasts set in and around Havana that explores Cuba's 1959 revolution: a young woman's fascination with the excess of an American-owned casino leads to her downfall in the eyes of her street vendor boyfriend; a tenant farmer revolts the only way he knows how, attacking the land he works; university students gain first-hand knowledge of political upheaval; and, in the hills outside the city, the members of a poor peasant family are patriotically swept up into the burgeoning revolt.

synopsis: Beautifully restored in 4K, Andrei Tarkovsky’s visionary final film unfolds in the hours before a nuclear holocaust.
tmdb_overview: Alexander, a journalist, philosopher and retired actor, celebrates a birthday with friends and family when it is announced that nuclear war has begun.

synopsis: Monic Vitti is engaging in this tale of revenge, fashion and nascent feminism in Swinging Sixties Britain.
tmdb_overview: A Sicilian woman is dishonored by her lover, then goes to London with a pistol intending to murder him.

synopsis: Krzysztof Kieślowski’s poetic masterclass tells the tale of two identical women whose lives only marginally intersect.
tmdb_overview: Véronique is a beautiful young French woman who aspires to be a renowned singer; Weronika lives in Poland, has a similar career goal and looks identical to Véronique, though the two are not related. The film follows both women as they contend with the ups and downs of their individual lives, with Véronique embarking on an unusual romance with Alexandre Fabbri, a puppeteer who may be able to help her with her existential issues.

tmdb_overview: Some time in the future, East and West have stopped maintaining standing armies and nuclear weapons. Instead, to settle their differences they pit different teams of crack combat specialists against each other.

synopsis: A cursed doll with a murder complex terrorises an unsuspecting family in this knowingly schlocky horror.
tmdb_overview: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her 6-year-old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.

synopsis: Maurice Pialat’s bracing and unsentimenal feature debut charts the life of a pre-teen boy in foster care.
tmdb_overview: Handed over to foster care by his mother—who's unwilling to give up permanent custody—the now-adolescent François understands that nothing in life is permanent, and his increasingly erratic actions reflect this knowledge.

But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

movie_title: International Dog Day: Isle Of Dogs
movie_title_en: International Dog Day: Isle Of Dogs
synopsis: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet. Starring Bryan Cranston, Koyu Rankin, Bob Balaban

After leaving the ultra-Orthodox world, 21-year-old Sarah sets out on a five-year journey, sparked by a raw, intimate expression of female vulnerability: an unplanned pregnancy. Without a permanent home, her changing body dictates the rhythm of her life as she moves between temporary apartments. Motherhood forces her to face herself, while the past she fled resurfaces. Caught between constant motion and inner withdrawal, Sarah struggles to form a new identity and find a place to call home.

The story of the relationship between Sophia, an eight-year-old girl who is growing up fast, and her grandmother, who is nearing the end of her life. They are spending time together with Sophia’s father, at the family summer house on a tiny unspoiled island in the Gulf of Finland. All three are coming to terms with the recent death of Sophia’s mother in very different ways.

tmdb_overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

A half hour animated film for all the family based on the much-loved book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler.  The Snail and the Whale is the much loved classic that shows us a restless young snail who has ambitions to travel the world. The other snails think she should stay put, but she puts out a call for a “Lift wanted around the world”. Eventually her call is answered by a great big grey-blue humpback whale! She sets off with him across the seas. On their journey the snail and the whale discover towering icebergs and far-off lands, fiery mountains and golden sands. The snail is delighted by the wonderful world around her, until she realises how small it makes her feel.

A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.

She sets off with him across the seas. On their journey the snail and the whale discover towering icebergs and far-off lands, fiery mountains and golden sands. The snail is delighted by the wonderful world around her, until she realises how small it makes her feel.

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

Marianela Nunez as Odette/Odile and Thiago Soares as Prince Siegfried bring new vitality to a compelling story of tragic romance. Valeriy Ovsyanikov conducts the Orchestra of the Royal Opera House in Tchaikovsky's glorious romantic score.

movie_title: Family Film Club: Beauty and the Beast
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Beauty and the Beast
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Beauty and the Beast - In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Dr Seuss' The Lorax
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Dr Seuss' The Lorax
synopsis:
A 12-year-old boy searches for the one thing that will enable him to win the affection of the girl of his dreams. To find it he must discover the story of the Lorax, the grumpy yet charming creature who fights to protect his world.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

synopsis:
Join us on Thursday, 6 August, for one night only as David Byrne’s American Utopia returns to Everyman - experience it like never before in stunning 4K alongside a special pre-recorded introduction by David Byrne.

Directed by Oscar-winner Spike Lee, David Byrne’s American Utopia is a groundbreaking cinematic event that inspires audiences to connect with each other and with the global community. 

This filmed version of the electrifying Broadway musical sensation brings Oscar, Grammy, and Golden Globe-winning musician David Byrne (Talking Heads) together with 11 musical artists from around the world to perform songs from across Byrne's career. Hailed by critics as "pure bliss," the performance is a joyful celebration of music and dance, a call to action to engage in our democracy, and an invitation to reimagine our own utopias.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movie_title: Family Film Club: Beauty and the Beast
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Beauty and the Beast
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Beauty and the Beast - In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Beauty and the Beast - In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

synopsis:
Join us on Thursday, 6 August, for one night only as David Byrne’s American Utopia returns to Everyman - experience it like never before in stunning 4K alongside a special pre-recorded introduction by David Byrne.

Directed by Oscar-winner Spike Lee, David Byrne’s American Utopia is a groundbreaking cinematic event that inspires audiences to connect with each other and with the global community. 

This filmed version of the electrifying Broadway musical sensation brings Oscar, Grammy, and Golden Globe-winning musician David Byrne (Talking Heads) together with 11 musical artists from around the world to perform songs from across Byrne's career. Hailed by critics as "pure bliss," the performance is a joyful celebration of music and dance, a call to action to engage in our democracy, and an invitation to reimagine our own utopias.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movie_title: Toddler Club: The Gruffalo's Child + The Scarecrow's Wedding
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Gruffalo's Child + The Scarecrow's Wedding
director: Uwe Heidschötter, Johannes Weiland, Jeroen Jaspaert
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE GRUFFALO'S CHILD
After learning about the Big Bad Mouse, Gruffalo's daughter chooses to ignore her father's warnings and embarks on a journey to find the creature in the dangerously cold winter.

THE SCARECROW'S WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

movie_title: Toddler Club: The Gruffalo's Child + The Scarecrow's Wedding
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Gruffalo's Child + The Scarecrow's Wedding
director: Uwe Heidschötter, Johannes Weiland, Jeroen Jaspaert
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE GRUFFALO'S CHILD
After learning about the Big Bad Mouse, Gruffalo's daughter chooses to ignore her father's warnings and embarks on a journey to find the creature in the dangerously cold winter.

THE SCARECROW'S WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
